name: Sterilization Protocol
source: Starfinder Society Scenario #1-07: Seize and Destroy
description: Nozzles on the walls spray hot water, chemical sanitizers, and superheated air at all creatures entering the U-shaped hall.
disable: DC 14 Computers (trained) to reprogram the system to safe levels, DC 14 Crafting (trained) to shut off the waterline, or DC 13 Thievery (trained) to cut power to the hall
reset: The trap automatically deactivates and resets if there are no creatures in the area.
routine: (2 actions) The trap sprays a powerful stream of superheated water and sanitizer at all creatures in the U-shaped hall, dealing 1d4 Bludgeoning Damage]{1d4 bludgeoning damage and 1d4 fire damage} (Basic DC 17 Reflex Saving Throw save).

defensiveAbilities.name: Steam Clean
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature ends its movement in the U-shaped hall

Effect The trap sprays a dense cloud of steam in the hall, obscuring vision. Creatures in the area are Concealed and creatures outside the hall are concealed to those within it. The trap then rolls initiative.
